preconditions.description: The number of people n is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
The number of friendships m is between n-1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j and 0 <= b <= 1 for i, j, b in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship is between two distinct people with valid indices and a valid envy direction.
The number of friendships matches the given m.

postconditions.description: The output starts with either 'YES' or 'NO'.
If the output starts with 'YES', there are exactly two additional lines.
If the output starts with 'NO', there are no additional lines.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for x in stdout.splitlines()[2].split())
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES', all incomes are between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.
If the output starts with 'YES', there are exactly n incomes.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == (int(stdout.splitlines()[1]) == max(int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[2].split()) - min(int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[2].split()))
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES', the second line is the maximum income inequality.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == all((a_i == a_j + 1 or a_j == a_i + 1) for i, j, b in friendships for a_i, a_j in [(int(stdout.splitlines()[2].split()[i-1]), int(stdout.splitlines()[2].split()[j-1]))])
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES', for every friendship, one person is envious of the other.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == all((a_i == a_j + 1) if b == 1 else True for i, j, b in friendships for a_i, a_j in [(int(stdout.splitlines()[2].split()[i-1]), int(stdout.splitlines()[2].split()[j-1]))])
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES', for every friendship with b=1, person i is envious of person j.
